mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals a severe labor market deterioration that triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 325) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle that increases real borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL exceeds 325 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500 during a late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals stronger economic output and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales decline below 700,000 million dollars in a month, it signals reduced consumer spending and weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS falls below 700000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signals a broad-based economic contraction across manufacturing and construction sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO is below 100 and HOUST is below 1500.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a CPI reading above 325 (index) signals persistent inflation that leads to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 325 during a monetary tightening cycle.
